evidenceNote: Integrity ranks documented natural construction first, then body-only claims, then synthetic blends; natural percentage breaks ties. It is not a hands-on quality score. Research includes Grok influencer threads/replies and r/PlasticFreeLiving comments; affiliate/brand posts are discovery leads, not independent proof. Organic/natural does not establish health benefit or absence of chemical residues.
